schemas.name: mill
schemas.title: Mill
schemas.description: One physical palm oil mill, the thing this register holds one record of.

columns.name: uml_id
columns.description: The Universal Mill List identifier — the one name a mill is addressed by.

columns.name: mill_name
columns.description: The mill's name as the mill register spells it.

columns.name: parent_group
columns.description: The group above the company that owns the mill.

columns.name: mill_company
columns.description: The company that owns the mill.

columns.name: capacity_tonnes_ffb_hour
columns.description: Tonnes of fresh fruit bunches the mill can process an hour.

columns.name: rspo_certified
columns.description: Whether the mill register records the mill as RSPO certified.

columns.name: rspo_supply_chain_model
columns.description: How the certified oil is kept apart downstream: identity preserved, segregated or mass balance.

columns.name: rspo_certificate_id
columns.description: The certificate the mill is certified under.

columns.name: mill_ghg_intensity_tco2e_per_t_cpo
columns.description: PalmGHG: tonnes of CO2 equivalent per tonne of crude palm oil, for this mill.

columns.name: latitude
columns.description: Decimal degrees north.

columns.name: longitude
columns.description: Decimal degrees east.

columns.name: sourcing_radius_km
columns.description: The circle the forest figures are measured over. A convention, not a measurement.

columns.name: forest_loss_ha_since_2001
columns.description: Hectares of tree cover lost inside that circle since 2001.

columns.name: forest_loss_ha_since_2015
columns.description: The same since 2015, the year the no-deforestation commitments date from.

columns.name: gross_emissions_mg_co2e_since_2001
columns.description: Tonnes of CO2 equivalent released by that loss since 2001.

columns.name: gross_emissions_mg_co2e_since_2015
columns.description: The same since 2015.

columns.name: worst_loss_year
columns.description: The year inside the circle that lost the most.

columns.name: unresolved_fields
columns.description: The fields this method went looking for and could not establish.

columns.name: conflict_note
columns.description: What disagreed, where a field was left blank because its sources did.

schemas.name: record
schemas.title: Record
schemas.description: One mill's settled values, each carrying the register or document that supplied it.

schemas.name: register
schemas.title: Register
schemas.description: A dataset pulled whole and dated. Three supply values here, and a fourth is what this method publishes.

columns.name: register:universal_mill_list
columns.description: The Universal Mill List pull: identity, ownership, location, certification.

columns.name: register:trase_indonesia_mills
columns.description: The Trase Indonesia pull: capacity.

columns.name: register:gfw_umd_tree_cover_loss
columns.description: Global Forest Watch: the forest and carbon figures, at the version named.

columns.name: document:<id>@<hash>
columns.description: A kept document, named and pinned to the hash of the bytes that were read.

schemas.name: source
schemas.title: Source
schemas.description: What supplied one value. Every published field names one, in one of these forms.

schemas.name: catalogue
schemas.title: Catalogue
schemas.description: The written list of documents this method pulls, and which fields each carries. Amending it is a change to the method.

columns.name: document_id
columns.description: The name this method files the document under.

columns.name: url
columns.description: Where it was fetched from. The kept copy, not this address, is what a claim rests on.

columns.name: publisher
columns.description: Who published it.

columns.name: published_date
columns.description: The date it states for itself.

columns.name: sha256
columns.description: The hash of the kept bytes. Blank where the address answered with nothing.

columns.name: found_by
columns.description: catalogue, where the method already listed it; search, where a run went looking.

columns.name: already_held
columns.description: Whether the store already had it, so the run paid nothing to get it.

columns.name: column_note
columns.description: How that publisher lays a row out, written down when the document was catalogued.

schemas.name: document
schemas.title: Document
schemas.description: A published source, fetched once and kept under the hash of its bytes.

columns.name: uml_id
columns.description: Which mill the passage was cut for.

columns.name: matched_on
columns.description: Whether the mill was found by its identifier or by its name.

columns.name: matched_line_count
columns.description: How many lines named the mill; at most five are kept.

columns.name: passage
columns.description: The kept lines, each with its line number in the stored words.

schemas.name: passage
schemas.title: Passage
schemas.description: The lines of one document that name one mill. What a reading is done over, and what a person checks against.

columns.name: claimed_parent_group
columns.description: The group the passage names, or blank.

columns.name: claimed_mill_company
columns.description: The company the passage names, or blank.

columns.name: claimed_capacity_tonnes_ffb_hour
columns.description: The capacity the passage states, or blank.

columns.name: claimed_rspo_certificate_id
columns.description: The certificate the passage states, or blank.

columns.name: claimed_ghg_intensity_tco2e_per_t_cpo
columns.description: The PalmGHG figure the passage states, or blank.

columns.name: claim_quote
columns.description: The exact text the answers rest on.

columns.name: claim_note
columns.description: What a reader of this claim needs told about the passage.

schemas.name: claim
schemas.title: Claim
schemas.description: What one passage states about one mill. Not yet a published value: a person confirms it first.

schemas.name: change_account
schemas.title: Change account
schemas.description: What appeared, vanished and moved since the previously published register.

schemas.name: parent_group
schemas.title: Parent group
schemas.description: The group above the company that owns the mill. The level accountability is usually argued at.

schemas.name: capacity
schemas.title: Capacity
schemas.description: How much fruit a mill can process, in tonnes of fresh fruit bunches an hour.

schemas.name: sourcing_radius
schemas.title: Sourcing radius
schemas.description: The circle around a mill its fruit is assumed to come from. A convention: loss inside it is loss NEAR the mill, never a claim about what the mill cleared.

schemas.name: palmghg
schemas.title: PalmGHG
schemas.description: RSPO's mill-level greenhouse-gas figure, in tonnes of CO2 equivalent per tonne of crude palm oil. Stated per mill inside an audit report; a group-level figure is not one.

verbs.name: enumerate
verbs.definition: Take the population of mills from the registers. Only a register enumerates; a document never adds a mill.

verbs.name: plan
verbs.definition: Decide, from a mill's blanks, which documents are worth pulling.

verbs.name: search
verbs.definition: Look for further addresses within the sources this method trusts. Returns addresses, never values.

verbs.name: fetch
verbs.definition: Retrieve a document and keep it under the hash of its bytes; one already held is not fetched again.

verbs.name: read
verbs.definition: Take from a passage what it states about a mill, and nothing it does not state.

verbs.name: measure
verbs.definition: Ask Global Forest Watch what was lost and released inside a mill's sourcing radius.

verbs.name: resolve
verbs.definition: Settle one value per field, with the source that supplied it.

verbs.name: confirm
verbs.definition: A person checks a value a document supplied against the passage behind it.

verbs.name: compare
verbs.definition: Set the register just published against the previous one.
